description: $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Live DNS lookup for any public host name: one record type or ALL (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA) in one call, with NXDOMAIN detection and a flag for private addresses. Cached 2 min. ~0.1-1 s.

host.description: Public host name, e.g. example.com or www.example.com (a URL also works)

type.description: Record type (default ALL = A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA)

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS lookup (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA)
